chase_cards.name: New Century Present
chase_cards.why: This is a chase because it is a club object more than a pack object: a summer 2000 Fan Club postcard, a 200 GET Points account event, and a century-turning celebration printed as a Jumbo Special Card.

key_artists.name: Sumiyoshi Kizuki
key_artists.why: Kizuki matters here because the card is social and celebratory rather than battle-forward. His art turns a Fan Club accounting event into a little festival card, which is exactly the kind of apparatus-history this catalog should preserve.

claims.text: The local catalog models Pokemon Card Fan Club (Summer 2000) as a one-row unnumbered promotional source group containing New Century Present at source index 194, with Postcard as the variant note.
Bulbapedia's unnumbered promotional list places New Century Present [Postcard] in the Pokemon Card Fan Club (Summer 2000) promotion.
Bulbapedia's New Century Present page says the card was sent to Pokemon Card Fan Club members in the summer of 2000.
Bulbapedia says members who were sent New Century Present received an additional 200 GET Points to their Pokemon Fan Club account.
Pokumon describes Fan Club jumbo postcards as mailings styled as Jumbo Trainer cards, used for events such as New Years or GET Point thresholds, with GET Points automatically credited to the member.
Bulbapedia credits New Century Present to Sumiyoshi Kizuki.
PokeBoon lists Sumiyoshi Kizuki as the illustrator for New Century Present and describes the object as a Jumbo Special Card postcard from Pokemon Card Fan Club Summer 2000.
Bulbapedia describes Sumiyoshi Kizuki as an illustrator who has contributed artwork to the Pokemon Trading Card Game.
Bulbapedia identifies New Century Present as a Special Card with the English expansion title Fan Club and says it was never released in English.
Bulbapedia says New Century Present is part of the Jumbo cards group and features the Pokemon Card Fan Club logo in place of an expansion symbol.

New Century Present matters as judged collector texture because the postcard format, Fan Club route, 200 GET Points account credit, and celebratory art turn membership itself into the collectible object.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, seller story, or agent memory says New Century Present, Pokemon Card Fan Club Summer 2000, Fan Club postcard, Jumbo postcard, 200 GET Points, Sumiyoshi Kizuki, New Year Present, Tropical Present, Fan Club Special Card, or unreleased in English.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Identify New Century Present by Fan Club Summer 2000 postcard/Jumbo route, 200 GET Points text, Sumiyoshi Kizuki art, and Fan Club logo before trusting generic Fan Club or Present-card memory.
steps: Confirm the object is New Century Present / ニューセンチュリープレゼント, not New Year Present or Tropical Present.
Confirm the distribution route is Pokemon Card Fan Club Summer 2000, with Fan Club member-mailing context.
Confirm the physical format is a postcard / Jumbo Special Card rather than a standard playable TCG card.
Look for the 200 GET Points award text or equivalent readable evidence on the card face.
Preserve Sumiyoshi Kizuki as illustrator and inspect the celebration/new-century art rather than substituting the Komiya New Year Present scene.
Look for the Pokemon Card Fan Club logo in place of an expansion symbol.
Inspect the reverse side as postcard evidence where available; address markings or used-postcard traces are condition/provenance evidence, not automatic authenticity.
Separate New Year Present, Tropical Present, ordinary Fan Club Pokemon cards, and later Fan Club/Players Club prizes unless source evidence proves this exact row.
Request seller front/back photos, size evidence, Fan Club logo evidence, 200 GET Points text, and postcard-back condition separately from catalog identity.

narrative.human_title: New Century Present: the Fan Club turns membership into a card
narrative.why_it_matters: New Century Present is not trying to be a pack chase. It is Pokemon as club infrastructure: a postcard-sized special card mailed to members, a 200 GET Points account moment, and a summer 2000 greeting dressed up as a collectible. The object is soft but very exact. It asks the agent to remember that belonging can leave paperwork, and sometimes that paperwork is the card.

narrative.human_title: New Century Present: the membership receipt with a grin
narrative.why_it_matters: New Century Present is wonderfully strange because the object is so gentle and so administrative at once. It is a postcard, a Jumbo Special Card, a Fan Club mailing, and a 200 GET Points moment. The card says that Pokemon collecting was not only opening packs or winning tournaments; it was being in the club, receiving mail, accumulating points, and letting a little illustrated celebration turn the account system into memory.
